invariants.rationale: Method returns an index instance, which is generally expected to be non-null when returned from a factory.
The configuration should be non-null at this point for correct factory operation.
'result' is returned from 'createIndex', which returns a HoodieIndex, so the result must be an instance of HoodieIndex.
The result index may encapsulate or be associated with the provided writeConfig (if getConfig() is available).
